title: AVRAG § 2: der Dienstzettel
source: Arbeitsvertragsrechts-Anpassungsgesetz (BGBl. Nr. 459/1993) § 2 as amended by BGBl. I Nr. 11/2024, in force 28 March 2024; ABGB § 1158 (2); Angestelltengesetz § 19 (2). RIS, read 2026-10-09.
note: A drafting check, not legal advice: the scripted rules read whether a particular is there, never whether a term is lawful.

rules.text: The Dienstzettel is handed over without delay after the start; the check holds it to the seven days of Art. 5(1) of Directive (EU) 2019/1152.
Both parties' names and addresses, the start, a fixed term's end, the notice period, notice dates and procedure, the usual place of work with the company's seat, any classification and the work.
The basic pay as an amount, the other elements such as the special payments, overtime pay, when and how it is paid.

The annual leave, the normal daily or weekly hours, the collective agreement and works agreements with the room where they can be read, and the social insurance institution and BV-Kasse with their addresses.
A probation of at most one month.
Only the items § 2 (5) names may point to a law or collective agreement; the basic pay never.
Work abroad over a month: the country and length, the currency, the return to Austria and the extra pay, before departure.
